findings: H100 两种点云微调共 14,520 次优化更新，加入 334,834 个模拟冠下缺测的监督回波视图。强遮挡留出测试固定屋缘召回为 90% 时，树冠保留从 37.86% 降至 25.64%。
实景点云与 NAIP 相差 96–212 天。7 栋有点云支持树冠而航片植被信号弱的情况，共 98 个参考点。反向冲突使用合成影像扰动。
全部 62 栋因实际时差、季节和配准证据不足沿用纯点云；几何和点权重逐栋核对相同。直接用航片改动了 13 栋的 386 个回波权重。
在真实留出样本上，四组贴树屋面命中依次 449、435、431、435 / 695。旧纯点云和新纯点云的全部屋面命中为 3,201 和 3,152 / 4,058。
合成影像单独出现树的 48 个屋面检查点中，纯点云和带保护的影像方案命中 46 个，直接影像降权命中 45 个。模拟中的可信影像资格专用于压力测试。
29 栋合成缺测移除 1,434 个回波。重新做 H100 推理和几何拟合后，旧模型和新模型命中 135、137 / 237 个屋面参考点。在另一个固定分类概率的诊断中，新增局部支撑标记将 171 个延伸位置的覆盖从 42 个提高到 164 个。

real_geometry.scope: Model-blind retrospective stability selection. Restricts conclusions to the matched roof interiors and canopy observations, and cannot validate missing or changed roof structures.
real_geometry.canopy_definition: Independent 2022 class 5 with coincident historical returns at least 0.75 m above two nearby stable roof points. Proximity to canopy observations cannot establish full canopy surface validity.
real_geometry.interpretation: Each building is equally weighted within a stratum. A roof hit is desirable; a canopy-height hit is an observed false-roof proxy. No XY coverage is a miss. Intervals resample paired buildings within the same fixed three DC test blocks.

frozen_disagreement_and_stress.real_disagreement_scope: Historical NAIP red/NIR is compared at independent 2022 points corroborated locally by historical 3DEP registered returns. Require every read across 1 m XY perturbation to be valid and to remain on the opposite side of the strict NDVI threshold. This documents spectral/geometric disagreement, without establishing acquisition-time tree loss, tree growth, phenology, or optical alignment.
frozen_disagreement_and_stress.stress_scope: Paired synthetic image-cue edits affect only a frozen 2 m local patch. Canopy presence and absence are paired replacements over the same target because measured native cue is already low there. No new historical photo is claimed. Reference coordinates choose benchmark patches before inference and never enter native fusion. Synthetic roof dropout removes only registered historical points close in height to a local roof reference patch selected near an independently corroborated canopy. The raw NPZs are unchanged.
frozen_disagreement_and_stress.same_grid_warning: Area classifications are model- and posterior-conditioned. Compare the paired roof-dropout masks at the same independent control positions for geometry-input support. Canopy-height roof matches are a false-roof proxy, whereas genuine roof matches are desirable.

local_support_audit.scope: Post-hoc diagnostic overlay only. An approximately 0.35 m roof cell is flagged when fewer than two distinct selected historical return locations within 0.5 m horizontally agree with its modeled height within 0.35 m. Uses neither classification probabilities nor reference geometry in overlay generation. Reference-only dropout scoring checks the frozen local points after removal. Geometry is unchanged.

roof_support_audit.scope: Synthetic lower-return omission. Refit and fixed-geometry support assessments use the same archived canopy-model probabilities. Areas are conditional on modeled roof and local point support.

end_to_end_dropouts.scope: Paired synthetic disappearance of frozen measured roof returns. The omitted points leave the full classifier context and the registered roof fit. Both frozen checkpoints run on the same remaining returns.

point_holdout.scope: Provider-labeled DC holdout. Raw XYZ-only inference. Partial/heavy canopy shadows selectively remove roof returns below observed overstory in simulation. Both models are scored on identical remaining source IDs. Native paired rows retain the original neighborhoods.
